g.text: A blocking-in for kernel, packs, and experiments
Stability decreases as you read upward. Mutability increases. The kernel carries the weight.

swappable · config-driven · 50–200 LOC each · zero cross-coupling unless declared
loaded unless an experiment opts out

Anatomy of a pack — PNN-Archive worked out
What "dial it in" looks like in practice. One pack. Two events in. One read API out. Zero kernel modification.
already exist · the pack just listens
No kernel file changes. No type shadowing. No new event types added.
EXPERIMENT MANIFEST · how an experiment dials it in

Direction is upward and slow. Default answer to "should this be promoted?" is no.

Print, mark up, hang on a wall. The kernel is the load-bearing element.
